items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: The Young Morgan band was the roughest after Sam got out of the picture, he got sick and when Isaiah took it over and then they began to get rough.

ctx.x: The Young Morgan with Sam added on or was it the old original Morgan band?
